Mission Bay Lofts

1234 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94103
$3,495 - $5,200 1-2 Beds 1-2 Baths 650-1,250 Sq Ft
  • In-Unit Washer/Dryer

Mission Bay Lofts offers thoughtfully designed 1- and 2-bedroom homes in the heart of San Francisco's Mission Bay neighborhood. Each residence features floor-to-ceiling windows, in-unit washer/dryers, stainless steel appliances, and hardwood floors. Building amenities include a rooftop deck with panoramic city views, a fully equipped fitness center, on-site management, and 24-hour doorman service.

Located within walking distance of UCSF Mission Bay, Oracle Park, and the Caltrain station, Mission Bay Lofts puts you at the center of San Francisco's most dynamic and rapidly growing district. Easy freeway access via I-280 and Highway 101 makes commuting throughout the Bay Area straightforward, while the Embarcadero waterfront is just a short walk away. Pet-friendly with a dog run on the roof deck. Move-in specials available for qualified applicants. Equal Housing Opportunity.
